writer: h2h12 serial CON writer and parallel gzip deflate. A path write publishes through the unnamed-file helper. The ranked default uses that same helper. Spare reuse is opt-in.
protocol: one warmup, n=12, type-7 median and IQR, serial, taskset -c 0-7, mpirun --bind-to core
headline: strong-threads.json, strong-mpi.json, weak-threads.json, weak-ranks-*.json, compressed.json, and conbin.json are default fresh-file writes
rewrite_table: rewrite.json is rewrite=True keep_spare=True. It is not the default, and the spare is a second copy of the file.
rel1_thread_writes: Some thread writes are slower than rel1 because each path write now publishes a fresh file. That is the landed writer.
